post_mortem_root_cause_analysis.finding: Cloud deployment (Render free tier) experienced severe out-of-memory crashes due to CCXT load_markets memory surge (928MB spike on 512MB RAM limit), causing repeated container restarts and wiping runtime state.
post_mortem_root_cause_analysis.lesson: Never use generic high-level SDK exchange initializers on RAM-constrained (<1GB) free containers. Direct single-pair REST endpoints must be enforced from day one.

post_mortem_root_cause_analysis.finding: Requiring a 100% ROI in 24 hours ($50 -> $100) on 1x paper spot without high-frequency tick scalping requires massive directional volatility that was absent in prevailing sideways/ranging market conditions.
post_mortem_root_cause_analysis.lesson: Aggressive short-window doubling targets cannot rely on conservative swing/trend filters without active leverage or ultra-high-frequency scalping.

post_mortem_root_cause_analysis.finding: GCP VM auto-deployment script terminated after SSH disconnect, leaving the remote cloud server running the stale August 27 build while updates were accumulating on GitHub.
post_mortem_root_cause_analysis.lesson: Cloud daemons must be registered as managed systemd services with restart policies, rather than background nohup bash scripts.

preserved_strategy_insights.best_architecture: AdaptiveGrid (tight 0.4% step / 0.8% TP) demonstrated the highest resilience during sideways consolidation.
preserved_strategy_insights.weakest_architecture: BreakoutHunter & AlphaTrend suffered high friction in low-ADX choppy markets without sustained trend expansion.
preserved_strategy_insights.polymarket_prediction_engine: Odds arbitrage requires high liquidity markets (> $500k volume) to prevent synthetic slippage.
